people.name: Sam Howard DeGreen
people.title_or_status: CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER & CHIEF COMPLIANCE OFFICER
people.bio_note: Founder, CEO, and CCO of DeGreen Private Wealth, launched August 2024. Series 65-licensed with about seven years in the industry; previously an investment advisor alongside his father at DeGreen Wealth Management, which was acquired by Allworth Financial in 2021. Builds the new firm around low-cost, transparent, tax-efficient ETF portfolios continuing a 30-year family tradition in wealth management. Hosts a weekly radio show/podcast, 'Freedom Through Finance,' Saturdays 6-7pm MST on News Talk 550 KFYI.
people.bio_source: accessnewswire.com press release on the firm's 2024 launch, corroborated by linkedin.com/in/sam-degreen-07309412b and SEC IAPD individual report (reports.adviserinfo.sec.gov/reports/individual/individual_6932311.pdf)

firm_note.text: DeGreen Private Wealth launched in August 2024 in Scottsdale as an independent, fee-only fiduciary RIA, built on a 30-year family tradition of wealth management (following the sale of the founder's prior firm, DeGreen Wealth Management, to Allworth Financial in 2021). The firm specializes in low-cost, tax-efficient, diversified ETF portfolios and partners with Charles Schwab for custody. Manages roughly $133M.
firm_note.source: accessnewswire.com press release 'DeGreen Private Wealth LLC Opens Its Doors in Scottsdale, Arizona' (also syndicated on newswire.com and europeanbusinessmagazine.com) — independent of the firm's own website
